title: Latency trajectory dashboard: model/route waveform and streaming split
creator: Priya Nandakumar
description:
Goal: Build a single-pane 'Latency Trajectory' dashboard that surfaces p50/p95/p99 latency behavior by model and route, with an explicit split for streaming vs non-streaming IO modes and waveform-style visualizations to show distribution shape and cohort drift over time.

Scope and panels: 
- Query surface: per-model, per-route selectors (model_family & route_id tags).
- IO mode split: two synchronized panes (streaming / non-streaming) + an aggregate view.
- Percentile timeline panel: p50/p95/p99 lines with shading for inter-percentile ranges.
- Waveform distribution strip: lightweight density/waveform for selected time window to show modal latency.
- Request-shape cohort selector: bucket by input token count / output token count / conversation turns.
- KV-cache warmness indicator: approximate hit-rate metric overlay to correlate cache state with tail latency.
- Exemplars + trace links: hover-to-link to OpenTelemetry trace IDs for tail samples.
- Error rate overlay: error % stacked onto latency to identify spike correlations.

Telemetry and instrumentation required: 
- Add stable labels: model_route (e.g., "gptx-13b:chat.v1"), io_mode (streaming|sync), request_shape_bucket (short|medium|long). Avoid adding user/customer ids to metrics to control cardinality.
- Expose OpenTelemetry histograms for server-side token timing and backend KV access timings; annotate histograms with exemplar trace IDs.
- Runtime tracing hooks: insert spans at servepath boundaries (ingest, routing, kernel_dispatch, kv_lookup, generation_loop, stream_frame_send). Each span must set model_route and io_mode attributes.
- Metrics pipeline: Prometheus remote_write -> Cortex with long-term aggregated histograms; logs to Loki for raw request samples with sampling at 1% for full payloads.

Queries / implementation notes (example): 
- p95 over 5m: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(latency_histogram_bucket{model_route="%MODEL%",io_mode="%IO%"}[5m])) by (le))
- exemplar link: use Prometheus exemplars storing otel.trace_id and surface in Grafana panel to link to traces.

Non-goals: per-customer drilldown (requires separate filtered dashboards), detailed token-level flamegraphs (follow-up story).

Acceptance criteria: 
1) Dashboard deployed in Grafana under Observability > Latency Trajectory and accessible to SRE/Platform/Runtime teams.
2) p50/p95/p99 panels show stable values for past 30d and correctly split by io_mode.
3) Exemplars link to traces and at least one KV span present in tail traces.
4) Alerts defined for p95 regressions relative to 7-day baseline and for sudden increase in error% on a model_route.

Artifacts: 
- Initial mockups: https://drive.redwood.ai/observability/latency-trajectory-mock.png
- Confluence spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Latency+Trajectory
- Prototype Grafana (read-only): https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abc123/latency-trajectory-proto
comments: 2026-03-02 - Priya: Kickoff meeting notes: agreed on core panels and stable label set. Platform concerns: cardinality risk if we add model_version tag; decision to use model_family+route only for metrics and reserve model_version for traces.

2026-03-04 - Miguel: Spike summary uploaded (PR-#1223) that adds io_mode attribute to runtime spans and emits OpenTelemetry histograms for per-request latency. Early results show KV lookup adds 12-18ms median on warm caches for some models.

2026-03-06 - Platform SRE (Ava Chen): Raised an alerting design question — should p95 alert be absolute threshold or relative to 7d baseline? Outcome: implement both; set a conservative absolute threshold for high-impact models and a relative drift alert for others.

2026-03-08 - Miguel: Found a metrics explosion in dev when request_shape_bucket used raw token counts. Fix: implement bucketing into short/medium/long at runtime (<=32, 33-256, >256). Updated PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1241

2026-03-10 - Design review (Jordan Li): Waveform panel mockups look good; suggested using low-opacity ridgeline to show density over time rather than full violin plots for readability at multi-model scale.

2026-03-12 - Miguel: Deployed prototype panels to staging Grafana. Real traffic tests indicate streaming tail p99 increases under bursty workloads; traced exemplar shows backpressure in stream_frame_send span. Logged follow-up ticket to optimize frame flush threshold (ENG-178632).

2026-03-14 - Priya: PM review: please add a short explainer in the dashboard describing recommended investigation steps when p95 drifts (check KV warmness, check kernel_dispatch queue length, look at token-length cohort).
Next steps: finish alerting rules, add runbook links in panel, QA with SRE on production canary, and schedule runtime optimization spike for streaming flush behaviour.
notes: Prefer Prometheus histograms + exemplars rather than per-request counters to keep cardinality manageable. Will coordinate with Observability infra to ensure Cortex compaction windows align with histogram retention needs.
